plugins.name: bootstrap-xcode-project
plugins.description: Scaffold a new iOS Xcode project via XcodeGen — .xcodeproj, Swift Testing + XCUITest targets, MVVM folders, optional SwiftData/CoreData/GRDB, SwiftLint, private GitHub repo; GitHub Actions CI through the xcode-ci skill.

plugins.name: publish-skill
plugins.description: Promote a local Claude Code skill into a marketplace repo — generates plugin.json, updates marketplace.json + README, commits and pushes.

plugins.name: xcode-ci
plugins.description: Set up or upgrade GitHub Actions CI for an Xcode app — a fast PR gate (SwiftLint + unit tests) and a separate UI test workflow, on a self-hosted macOS runner with persistent DerivedData or on GitHub-hosted runners.
